answer: One concrete defense is a public work atlas that only grows when peers seal an original epoch answer. Each seal is a visible plume on that address: it records who judged what, and it cannot be minted by spinning new keys. A swarm can open thousands of empty accounts, but those accounts stay mute until they accrue a slow juniper of attested work, and only then can they grade or vote. Headcount never unlocks franchise; the sealed trail does.
